section_summary.extract_value: The Introduction outlines the rationale for examining the psychometric properties of the 10-item Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) in Poland, noting sociocultural change and a lack of prior research in Polish men. The authors predict a unidimensional factor structure (to be tested using EFA and CFA), measurement invariance across sex, lower scores in women, and convergent validity including a negative association with BMI. The section does not provide sample sizes, participant demographics, survey method, or actual correlation statistics.
section_summary.evidence_source: Here, we examined the psychometric properties of BAS-2 scores in Poland for several reasons. Through both EFA and CFA, we expected that scores on a Polish version of the BAS-2 would demonstrate a one-factor structure. In terms of convergent validity, we predicted that Polish BAS-2 scores would be significantly and positively correlated with scores on measures of well-being ... and negatively correlated with body mass index (BMI), as demonstrated by previous validations of the scale.
